desc.en: Provides several unique fonts for personal or commercial use.
desc.zh: 提供多款独特字体，可用于个人或商业用途。

desc.en: The fonts presented on this website are their authors' property and are either freeware, shareware, demo versions, or public domain.
desc.zh: 本网站提供的字体归其作者所有，分别为免费软件、共享软件、演示版本或公有领域。

desc.en: Offers multiple tools; @font-face, Units Converter, Font Hinter and Font Submitter.
desc.zh: 提供多种工具：@font-face、单位转换器、字体微调器（Font Hinter）和字体提交器。

desc.en: Identify all the fonts used on a website and how they are used.
desc.zh: 识别网站上使用的所有字体及其使用方式。

desc.en: Freeware fonts licensed for commercial work. Hand-selected these typefaces and presented them in an easy-to-use format.
desc.zh: 可用于商业用途的免费软件字体。手工挑选这些字体并以便于使用的格式呈现。

desc.en: Has a variety of fonts available to download and sorted neatly with tags.
desc.zh: 提供多种字体可供下载，并通过标签整齐分类。

desc.en: free and open source service for delivering font families to websites using CSS.
desc.zh: 免费开源服务，通过 CSS 向网站提供字体族。

desc.en: Opensourced Google fonts tagged by users. With CJK (Chinese,Japanese, Korean) font tags.
desc.zh: 由用户打标签的开源 Google 字体，含 CJK（中文、日文、韩文）字体标签。

desc.en: is a free fonts service. It’s a growing collection of professional-grade fonts, 100% free for personal and commercial use.
desc.zh: 是一项免费字体服务，汇集了不断增长的专业级字体，个人与商业用途均 100% 免费。

desc.en: Many free fonts are easy and quick to install on a website via a download or a link to Google's CDN.
desc.zh: 许多免费字体可通过下载或链接 Google 的 CDN 轻松快速地安装到网站上。
